summary: This diff adds Permits create/PDF-upload, a new Drawings & 3D module, Documents upload, and a new Minutes of Meeting module to PROJEXA, all as thin proxy routes over compliance-tracker's existing documents table (category-discriminated) and veri-meeting-service.ts, following the codebase's established requireAuth()+callVeridian() pattern exactly (including a new callVeridianUpload() multipart twin for file uploads, which correctly lets fetch set its own Content-Type boundary). Manual review of every new/changed file (page.tsx entries, API routes, PermitsClient/DrawingsClient/MoMsClient/DocumentsClient, veridian-client.ts) found no missing imports, broken references, or logic errors; icons and shared helpers (resolveSelectedProject, getServerOrganizationId) are real and used correctly. The architecture decision to reuse the documents table rather than fork new constructionPermits/Drawings/Documents tables is sound and well-justified, avoiding schema/migration risk entirely, and the WhatsApp-send gap is honestly disclosed via a disabled button rather than faked. The diff touches no .github/workflows/**, migrations, schema.ts, auth/, or .env files, consistent with its tier1 classification. The one real gap is self-disclosed in PROGRESS.md: the PROJEXA-side tsc/test run was never executed this session and no proxy-route tests were added for the new api/permits, api/drawings, api/documents, or api/moms/* routes (unlike the compliance-tracker half, which has real passing tests) -- this workspace has no node_modules installed so it could not be independently verified here, but the code is straightforward boilerplate matching working precedent files closely enough that this is a reasonable follow-up item rather than a merge blocker.
issues: PROJEXA-side verification (npx tsc --noEmit, bun test) was not run this session per the worker's own PROGRESS.md -- should be run before/shortly after merge to catch any compile errors in the new routes/components.

No proxy-route tests were added for the new/edited api/permits, api/drawings, api/documents, api/moms/* routes (compliance-tracker side has real tests; PROJEXA side does not) -- recommend a fast-follow task to add them matching the existing scope/[id]/revisions/route.test.ts mock.module() convention.

This PR's counterpart compliance-tracker changes (worktree feat/projexa-permits-drawings-moms) are described as not yet committed/pushed/opened as a PR per PROGRESS.md -- confirm that side lands before this PROJEXA half is merged, since these routes proxy to endpoints that must exist on VERIDIAN's side to function.
